name: Creamy Lemon Dill Shrimp with Butter Lettuce, Radish & Parmesan Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch fresh dill
½ lemon
½ bunch radish
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slowly add cream to the pan, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer, then lower heat and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the sauce has thickened, juice lemon into the pan. Add dill, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Cover to keep warm.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ shallot
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 340 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Add sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add half to the bowl with the lettuce and gently toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide salad and shrimp between plates or bowls. Top with shrimp with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!
